context_requirements: TPP2 expression is ubiquitous; no known lineage or mutation restriction for target engagement
A transcriptional response would require sufficient TPP2 inhibition to impair tripeptidyl peptidase activity and downstream peptide turnover
No validated transcriptional signature of TPP2 inhibition is known in these cell lines
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent transcriptional signature shared across multiple cell lines at 6 h or 24 h would contradict the expectation of no specific response
Selective changes in known TPP2-dependent pathways or peptides would indicate a missed mechanism-specific response
Consistent induction of generic stress, apoptosis, or cell-cycle programs at 10 micromolar would suggest off-target or nonspecific effects rather than TPP2-specific transcription
